pattern: SELECT {cols} FROM {table} ORDER BY {sort_col} DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT u.name, wt.amount, wt.transaction_type FROM wallet_transaction wt JOIN users u ON wt.user_id = u.id LIMIT 500;
SELECT id, name, email, phone FROM companies LIMIT 500;
SELECT id, user_id, amount, status FROM withdrawal_request WHERE status = '{status}' LIMIT 500;
